title: D-024 B1: telemetry core + primary-session ingestion (shadow mode)
objective: Implement the passive telemetry foundation: typed telemetry records with source/confidence labels (provider-exact, sdk-task-cumulative, subagent-status-live, sdk-cumulative, status-live, transcript-derived, estimated, unknown; missing usage is unknown, never zero), atomic sidecar/journal writes, redaction, bounds, rotation; primary-session status-line JSON ingestion (nullable fields at startup/after compaction) and main-loop structured provider usage ingestion (per-step vs cumulative kept distinct, message-ID dedup) with zero model-context injection - no additionalContext, no routine prompts, no worker-visible counters. Current live context occupancy and cumulative spend remain separate categories. Actuation stays off (shadow). Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R100 (Phase B).
business_reason: D-024 sections 5, 5.1-5.3, 15-B: out-of-band event-driven measurement is the prerequisite for every later supervision decision; prompts-as-telemetry are prohibited.
